title: Quran Study from Parivash 32: Short Excerpt on Quran 24:55, Quran 22:15, Mosques, and Children (1989-12-28)

cases.question: What promise appears in Quran 24:55?
cases.expected_answer_note: The excerpt begins with the promise of sovereignty and security for those worshiping God alone. The group contrasts Rashad's reading of Quran 22:15 with older English and Turkish translations that are mocked as commanding a person to hang himself.
